metadata.title: On pluriclosed torsion-critical Hermitian metrics
metadata.abstract: In our previous work, we studied the squared $L^2$-norm functionals $\mathcal G$ of Gauduchon's torsion $1$-form and $\mathcal F$ of the Chern torsion over the space of all Hermitian metrics with unit volume on a compact complex manifold. We introduced torsion-critical metrics as critical points of $\mathcal F$. In this paper, We prove that a pluriclosed and astheno-Kähler metric is torsion-critical if and only if it is Kähler. In particular, every compact pluriclosed torsion-critical Hermitian threefold is Kähler. We also give explicit examples and derive geometric consequences under additional curvature assumptions.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 挠率能量临界度量的Kähler刚性
analysis.workSummary: 在紧复流形的单位体积Hermitian度量空间中，以Chern挠率的L²范数泛函𝒡的临界点定义torsion-critical度量。作者证明同时pluriclosed与astheno-Kähler的度量，挠率临界当且仅当Kähler。特别地，紧复三维pluriclosed挠率临界度量必为Kähler。
techniques: 附加曲率下的几何推论
analysis.breakthrough: 将一类非Kähler候选临界点排除，并在复三维无需另列astheno条件即得到刚性。
analysis.limitations: 紧性与pluriclosed、astheno-Kähler两类条件须按维数保留，例子与曲率推论需正文确认。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
